npmProductionScope.countMeaning: Entries include parents affected through vulnerable transitive dependencies. Production dependency declarations also contain build and emulator tools
npmProductionScope.scopeComparison: The 34 production-scope entries and 38 full-install entries use different scopes. Their difference is not a remediation result

priorityFindings.observedReachability: Report drafts, module insights, decisions and species functions call generateText through openai-compatible. Its JSON success/error handlers reach response.text() without the shared byte limit; nonstream generation uses this path
priorityFindings.impactCondition: An oversized response from the configured AI upstream can exhaust response-reading memory. The app uses a fixed gateway URL; arbitrary caller-selected upstream URLs were not found
priorityFindings.patchCandidate: >=4.0.33 is a patch release within the installed 4.x line. Both ai@6.0.191 and @ai-sdk/openai-compatible@2.0.48 pin exactly 4.0.27, so a normal transitive refresh cannot replace those exact pins. A tested compatible parent update or scoped override must make both paths resolve the patched version; response-boundary tests are required
priorityFindings.status: Existing reachable response-reader issue; remediation was not performed

priorityFindings.observedReachability: The existing built server contains _libs/ajv.mjs importing _libs/fast-uri.mjs. App-level hostname allowlists using fast-uri output were not found
priorityFindings.impactCondition: Host-confusion advisories require using parser output for a trust decision before routing the original URI. Such a customer bypass was not demonstrated
priorityFindings.patchCandidate: >=3.1.8 to cover the observed 3.x ranges; retain MCP/AJV compatibility checks
priorityFindings.status: Existing server-bundled package; exploit prerequisite remains unproven

priorityFindings.observedReachability: The Lovable adapter imports McpServer and WebStandardStreamableHTTPServerTransport. The app configures a fixed OAuth issuer as a server; outbound SDK OAuth-client use was not found
priorityFindings.impactCondition: The advisory affects OAuth clients holding credentials while connecting to an untrusted MCP server. The vendor explicitly excludes SDK server use
priorityFindings.patchCandidate: 1.31.0 or later in the 1.x line through a tested vendor update or scoped compatible override
priorityFindings.status: Existing pinned advisory; the observed server path does not meet this advisory's client prerequisite

priorityFindings.observedReachability: DOMPurify exists in the built library set. App PDF code uses jsPDF text and drawing methods; jsPDF.html, app DOMPurify calls, IN_PLACE and sanitizer hooks were not found
priorityFindings.impactCondition: These findings require in-place node sanitization and a relevant hook or serialize/reparse path. That report-output path was not observed
priorityFindings.status: Existing report dependency; current advisory prerequisites were not observed

priorityFindings.impactCondition: Untrusted strings must reach affected hono/jsx server boundary/root positions. No app hono/jsx rendering path was found; the app uses React/TanStack
priorityFindings.status: Existing transitive package; affected rendering path was not observed

priorityFindings.observedScope: Installed build/watch tooling. Current app source does not expose customer CSS/YAML/glob processing through these packages
priorityFindings.impactCondition: Exposure changes if a vulnerable development server is reachable by untrusted users or builds ingest attacker-controlled source/configuration
priorityFindings.action: Choose compatible patch updates and watch/build regression tests in a separate slice; npm parent fixAvailable is not proof of a braces leaf patch
priorityFindings.status: Existing tooling findings; deployed development-server exposure was not checked

priorityFindings.observedScope: Pinned emulator/build dependency paths. Customer JPEG original validation uses structural checks and exifr; an app sharp/undici/ws import was not found
priorityFindings.impactCondition: Actual Undici proxy/cache/WebSocket or native image-processing use must be traced before assigning customer-runtime exposure. Cloudflare fetch and Node's built-in fetch have separate implementations
priorityFindings.action: Assess Cloudflare/Nitro/Miniflare parent compatibility and both dependency copies; do not run audit fix --force or force a beta parent upgrade
priorityFindings.status: Existing conditional findings; parent/native upgrades were not tested

separateActivationGate.observation: The four AI server functions inspected show no requireSupabaseAuth middleware or explicit abortSignal. They cap caller input/output tokens but use the upstream JSON response path
separateActivationGate.action: Before enabling customer-facing AI calls, verify ordinary auth, rate/concurrency and response deadline/byte limits in a separate authorized change; keep missing-key branches disabled where applicable

releaseAcceptance.nextAction: Continue the scoped source10 candidate without attributing old advisory totals to proj4. Schedule the reachable AI JSON reader and compatible runtime hygiene patches separately, with clean-install/typecheck/tests/build and a fresh audit tied to the exact resulting lock
